evidence.reason: P36 (pr62-cleanup f620a851, decision U5 in acceptance-reports/pr62-cleanup/PARENT-RULING-PR62-TEST-CLEANUP.md; hand record, no --bless). src/lib/desktop/native-revision-controller.ts and native-revision-session.ts had no production importer; their only consumer, native-live-graph.browser.test.ts (one test, the whole of gate rc1-g-native-live-graph-browser, 1 pass), is deleted with them. A whole-file deletion is not admissible through --allow-removal, so the gate leaves `gates` as one whole-array change, the entry diffJson records when the array's length changes. Direct audit of the deleted test's 11 result keys against production tests: bankSeam and proofGate are covered by native-schedule-coordinator.test.ts `staged bank preserves exact held-note seam ownership and requires publication proof`; bankRebase by `discarding a staged bank leaves active accepted windows and refills intact` plus the added `a bank re-staged at a later frame carries that frame as its publication seam` (9efec8c4; fails with preparedPublicationFrame mutated to the window start). The other eight keys exercised the deleted controller, which production does not use; the production revision path has lostReply (native-playback-controller.test.ts `W03 lost Publish retains caller until native proof`), reconciled (`W17 post-ACK publish-pending is conclusive with one Inspect`), noBlindRollback (`W42 published ACK never rolls back the active latency bank`), partial analogues for ownership, outOfOrder, latest and monotonicUndo, and no test for an exact 64-bit publication frame (noted in the final report).
